washing-machine.definition: A machine that washes and rinses clothes.
washing-machine.exampleUsage: Maya puts the laundry in the washing machine.

dryer.definition: A machine that removes moisture from wet clothes.
dryer.exampleUsage: The dryer holds the wet towels after washing.

front-loader.definition: A washing machine with a door on the front through which laundry is loaded.
front-loader.exampleUsage: The front-loader uses a horizontal drum.

top-loader.definition: A washing machine with a lid on the top through which laundry is loaded.

spin-cycle.definition: The washing-machine stage that rotates the drum rapidly to extract excess water.
spin-cycle.exampleUsage: The spin cycle removes excess water before drying.

rinse.definition: The removal of soap with clean water in the final stage of washing.
rinse.exampleUsage: The rinse removes detergent from the clothes.

wash.definition: To clean clothes using water and a suitable cleaning product, or the washing process.
wash.exampleUsage: The wash has finished, but the clothes are still wet.

tumble-dry.definition: Dry laundry by rotating it inside a drum while heated air removes its moisture.
tumble-dry.exampleUsage: The label permits us to tumble dry this item.

coin-slot.definition: An opening for inserting coins to pay for a machine.
coin-slot.exampleUsage: Omar checks whether the coin slot accepts his coins.

start-button.definition: A button used to begin a machine’s operation.
start-button.exampleUsage: Omar reads the instructions before pressing the start button.

detergent.definition: A cleaning product used to wash clothes.
detergent.exampleUsage: Omar checks the detergent container before choosing it.

fabric-softener.definition: A laundry product used during washing or rinsing to make fabrics feel softer and reduce static.
fabric-softener.exampleUsage: The label explains where fabric softener may be used.

bleach.definition: A product used to remove color or whiten suitable materials; use depends on garment and product directions.
bleach.exampleUsage: The garment label does not permit bleach.

stain-remover.definition: A cleaning product designed to help remove marks or stains from fabric or other surfaces.
stain-remover.exampleUsage: The stain remover was tested on an inconspicuous area first.

dryer-sheet.definition: A thin sheet placed in a clothes dryer to reduce static and add softness or fragrance.
dryer-sheet.exampleUsage: A dryer sheet was placed with the laundry according to the package directions.

lint-roller.definition: A hand-held sticky roller used to remove lint, hair, or small fibers from clothing.
lint-roller.exampleUsage: The lint roller removed pet hair from the jacket.

clothespin.definition: A small clip used to fasten laundry to a drying line.
clothespin.exampleUsage: A clothespin holds the towel on the line.

mesh-bag.definition: A bag made from net-like fabric, often used to protect small or delicate laundry items during washing.
mesh-bag.exampleUsage: Delicate socks were placed in a mesh bag.

shirt.definition: A garment worn on the upper body, usually with sleeves.

pants.definition: Trousers in American English; in British English the word often means underwear.
pants.exampleUsage: His pants cover his legs from the waist to the ankles.

socks.definition: Hosiery consisting of a cloth covering for the foot.

underwear.definition: Undergarment worn next to the skin and under the outer garments.
underwear.exampleUsage: The underwear is worn beneath outer clothes.

towel.definition: A piece of absorbent cloth used for drying your body or other things.
towel.exampleUsage: The towel absorbs water after a shower.

dress.definition: A one-piece garment with a skirt covering the upper body and part of the legs.
dress.exampleUsage: The dress has its own care label.

jacket.definition: A short outer garment worn over other clothes.
jacket.exampleUsage: The jacket goes over the shirt.

jeans.exampleUsage: Omar keeps his jeans separate until he checks their label.

sort.definition: To separate clothes into groups before washing.
sort.exampleUsage: Maya sorts the laundry before loading the machine.

load.definition: To put clothes into a washing machine or dryer.
load.exampleUsage: Omar loads the machine with suitable laundry.

unload.definition: To remove the load from (a container or vehicle).
unload.exampleUsage: They unload the clothes after the cycle finishes.

fold.definition: To bend clothing over itself into a compact shape for storage.
fold.exampleUsage: Maya folds the dry towels on the table.

iron.definition: A heated appliance used to smooth wrinkles in clothes.
iron.exampleUsage: The iron stays on the shelf until needed.

hang.definition: To place wet clothes on a line or rack to dry.
hang.exampleUsage: Omar hangs the shirt to dry.

stain-treat.definition: To apply a suitable cleaning treatment to a stain before or during laundering.
stain-treat.exampleUsage: She treated the stain according to the garment-care label.

pre-soak.definition: To soak laundry in water or a cleaning solution before the main wash.
pre-soak.exampleUsage: The care instructions recommend a short pre-soak for the muddy uniform.

spin.definition: To rotate quickly around a central point.
spin.exampleUsage: The machine’s drum begins to spin.

dry.definition: Without remaining moisture; also to remove moisture from something.
dry.exampleUsage: The shirt is dry now and can be put away.

folding-table.definition: A flat table used for sorting and folding clean laundry.
folding-table.exampleUsage: Clean clothes were folded on the folding table.

cart.definition: A wheeled container used to move laundry.
cart.exampleUsage: Maya moves the towels in a cart.

bench.definition: A long seat for several people.
bench.exampleUsage: Omar waits on the bench near the machines.

vending-machine.definition: A machine that sells products after payment.
vending-machine.exampleUsage: The vending machine sells packaged laundry products.

change-machine.definition: A machine that exchanges bills or larger coins for smaller coins or tokens.
change-machine.exampleUsage: The change machine provided coins for the laundry machines.

sign.definition: A board or notice giving information.
sign.exampleUsage: The sign shows the laundromat’s opening hours.

floor-drain.definition: An opening in a floor that allows water or other liquid to flow into a drainage system.
floor-drain.exampleUsage: The floor drain helps remove spilled water.

lost-and-found.definition: A place where lost belongings are collected or reported.
lost-and-found.exampleUsage: Omar asks at lost and found about his scarf.

label.definition: A small attached piece showing care or identification information.
label.exampleUsage: The shirt’s label specifies how it may be washed.

delicate.definition: Easily damaged and needing careful handling.
delicate.exampleUsage: The delicate shirt needs careful handling.

cotton.exampleUsage: The shirt is made from cotton fabric.

wool.definition: Soft hair from sheep, used to make warm cloth.
wool.exampleUsage: The wool sweater has its own care instructions.

silk.definition: A fabric made from silk fibers produced by silkworms.
silk.exampleUsage: The silk shirt has a specific care label.

cold-wash.definition: A laundry wash cycle that uses cold or cool water.
cold-wash.exampleUsage: The care label recommends a cold wash.

warm-wash.definition: A laundry wash cycle that uses warm water.
warm-wash.exampleUsage: The machine has a warm-wash setting.

tumble-dry-low.definition: A clothing-care instruction meaning to dry the item in a tumble dryer using low heat.
tumble-dry-low.exampleUsage: The care label says 'tumble dry low.'

hang-dry.definition: To dry clothing by hanging it in the air rather than using a tumble dryer.
hang-dry.exampleUsage: The delicate shirt should hang dry.

dry-clean-only.definition: A care-label instruction meaning the item should be professionally dry-cleaned rather than washed normally.
dry-clean-only.exampleUsage: The jacket label says 'dry clean only.'

timer.definition: A device that measures a time interval or signals when it ends.
timer.exampleUsage: Omar sets a timer to remind him to return.

basket.definition: A container used to carry clothes.
basket.exampleUsage: The basket carries the clean laundry.

hanger.definition: A shaped support on which clothes hang from the shoulders.
hanger.exampleUsage: The shirt hangs on a hanger.

measuring-cup.definition: A cup marked for measuring a quantity.
measuring-cup.exampleUsage: The measuring cup shows the quantity being measured.

sheet.definition: A large piece of cloth used as bedding on a mattress.
sheet.exampleUsage: Maya checks the sheet’s care label.

blanket.definition: A thick bed covering used for warmth.
blanket.exampleUsage: The blanket keeps Omar warm at night.
